instruction:
Task: Add multiple translations to the 'Historial de Traducciones' until its content overflows the designated container, then attempt to scroll the history area.
Expected Result: The history area becomes scrollable. The user can successfully scroll up and down to view older translation messages. Each message in the history should maintain its well-formatted and easy-to-read structure.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
